### Q118: the per-stage work blocks — FIXED in the summary; the reader's read REPORTED; CONFIRMED

* **The blocks.** `groups[].stageWork[stage][counter]` in f-03b's block form `{ stage, unit, units, unitsTotal,
  perUnit }` + `charged`, for every counter `STAGE_CHARGES` gives S1, S3, S4, S5, S6 (route.nodes at S3, S4, S5; the
  five kernel counters at every stage). Pinned by `summary.test.ts` "STAGE_WORK is M0-f-03b's STAGE_CHARGES …",
  "every stage that ran … has a block of n > 0 …" and "read in M0-f-03b's reader form, one stage per group, … no e-06
  row unbounded" (`fitWorkLimits` on the committed summaries), all green in NEAR. Mutants: C5 (no-op batches counted)
  and C7 (the floor not subtracted in the units' read-back) red on `fold.test.ts`; C6 (S5's route.nodes row dropped)
  red on `compose.test.ts` "the record's per-stage work rows …".
* **The dry run.** `PLAT_BENCH_OUT=… corepack pnpm bench -- worklimits --date 2026-10-31` in the mirror: exit 1;
  29 rows unbounded, 20 of them e-06's, for example "worklimits: M0-e-06 groups/0 (relief-60/default) S3: 536
  batches, E_WORK_LIMIT before 0, after UNBOUNDED — no block for insert.points, …, route.nodes (never counted as 0)"
  (`out/wl-dry.log`). The reason is the reader's form, read in `bench/src/worklimits/fit.ts`: `e06Groups` reads
  `groups[i].work[counter]` with one `stage` per counter key, and `countingKeys` refuses a key the table has no row for,
  so five stages' kernel blocks cannot be carried in `work`; carrying them as extra groups would change the summary's
  group format that the reader and `summary.test.ts` read. Making the dry run green needs f-03b's one-loop change
  (read `stageWork[stage]` where present), a file outside e-06's owns: REPORTED with that contract reason (C-0453
  REPORTED (i), notes N-s3-2), not a failing line.
* **N-s2-2 restated** with the new units in the notes (route.nodes n per stage; S4 still thin on relief-3000): present.
